behavioural.q: Tell me about a disagreement with a colleague and how you resolved it.
Give an example of building rapport with someone who was difficult to work with.
A teammate presented shared work and took all the credit. How did or would you handle it?
Your teammates were not satisfied with your work. How did you work through it?
Tell me about a time you could not finish a project by its deadline. What did you do?
A strict-deadline project was taken away from you midway, or changed at the last minute. How did you respond?
Everything on your plate is P0. How do you prioritise?
How did you push a project forward without having all the information?
How would you bring structure to a constantly changing environment like Google's?
Describe working with other teams where you had to influence them.
Have you led or guided teammates? What was your role on a long (over 3 months) project?
Tell me about a time you showed bias for action to remove a bottleneck.
Your team feels overwhelmed. How would you approach it?
Tell me about negative feedback you received and how you handled it.
Tell me about a mistake or your biggest disappointment, and what you learned.
Tell me about a time you advocated for users even when it was hard.
Someone struggled to fit into a culturally diverse team. How did you help?
